verdict.rationale: HubSpot offers a documented MCP server giving AI agents read/write access to CRM data (contacts, deals, engagements) and REST APIs for contacts/custom objects, which could be composed by an agent into an account brief covering deals and history. However, there's no explicit evidence of a pre-built 'account brief' feature combining open deals, recent emails, and meeting history in one call, nor documented email-content retrieval via API/MCP for 'recent emails' specifically.
